profile.headline: Always learning new things
profile.summary:
I have been working as a software developer for 3 years, using ASP.NET C#, HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, as well as using popular JavaScript Libraries to improve and optimize web projects. 

- Full-stack 
Back: ASP.NET C#, DB: Microsoft SQL Server
Front: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, Razor

- Other experienced tools & APIs
Tensorflow: Detect images and optimize the crop based on usages with Machine Learning
Three.js: Create a 3D Product model dynamically to show products in web browsers using WebGL
Rest APIs from popular websites to get photos like Facebook or Google
ImageMagick, GDI+: Create, Edit and Manipulate Images uploaded from clients.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Improved the website performance and design to increase the revenue and SEO Rank to #1 for relevant keywords (photo mosaic for Mosaically)

Worked on projects

<Improving Website Performance>
- Minimize First Contentful Paint and First Input Delay by optimizing client rendering time and server response time with JavaScript, C# and EF6.
- Improved Full Resolution (18,000 x 18,000 or higher in pixels) Mosaic Rendering Time around 2 minutes to 1 minute, and provided smooth transition by providing low resolution image first to increase User Expereince
- Full redesign, and implementation of Mosaic viewing page by separating & prioritizing critical UI parts first which results in faster loading & response (around 30 kbs of JS codes taken out from initial page loading)
- Other webpage loading parts with reduced DB calls or optimization with Memory & Threads and async reduced the server response time by half or more.

<3D Product Models on Web>
Utilizing Three.js and GDI+ to make a 3D product preview per product types that customers can see on their devices (You can check different 3D Models of prints per product type after clicking Buy Now on the mosaic page.)
- Each product has different constraints (whitespaces, wrapping, reflections) as well as different covers for sides and back
- Each product 3D image has been cropped from the original image using GDI+ on the back end to the size of powers of 2

<Utilizing Tensorflow>
Extracts many useful features from the photos to find the intelligent cropping position from the image
- Tensorflow GPU handles graph inference to extract many important features of the image
- Face, Image Segmentation, ...
- Provides good enough cropping results without relying on 3rd party solutions

o	Migrated the project from old ASP.NET project to ASP.NET MVC 5 and latest Entity Framework version while managing conflicts from all other code bases
o	Built & applied OAuth Logins and Access Token mechanism to access user information from endpoints from front to back

Degree-seeking undergraduate students are eligible for Dean's List if their term GPA is greater than or equal to 3.400; they do not have any grades of "Incomplete", "D" or "F"; and they have registered for, and completed, at least 12 credit hours.
